annotation.evidence_span: An endpoint SHOULD copy the error code from the STOP_SENDING frame to the RESET_STREAM frame it sends, but can use any application error code.
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint copies the exact error code from the STOP_SENDING frame into the RESET_STREAM frame.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint ignores the STOP_SENDING error code and may use any application error code it chooses for the RESET_STREAM frame.
annotation.justification: The clause simultaneously requires copying the STOP_SENDING error code and permits using any application error code, yielding two materially different implementation behaviours.
